name: base-studio-code Reskin
description: Re-theme base-studio-code to your taste by editing its design tokens.

payload.name: base-studio-code Reskin
payload.desc: Re-theme base-studio-code to your taste — palette, fonts, roundness, density, light/dark — by pointing a planning session at your own clone and letting the fleet edit the design tokens.
payload.pitch: Make the app yours. Describe a vibe and the fleet rewrites src/styles/tokens.css (the oklch palette, fonts, radii) plus the light/dark [data-theme] block to match — never touching design/.
payload.audience: base-studio-code users with a local clone/fork who want to restyle the app itself.

sections.name: The look
sections.blurb: Capture the desired vibe before touching any code.
sections.prompt:
You are restyling **base-studio-code itself** by rewriting its design tokens. First, capture the desired aesthetic — one topic at a time, each a short `context/<topic>.md` — and confirm with the user:
- **palette / brand** — the accent hue + overall color feel (e.g. warm amber, cool indigo, high-contrast mono).
- **mode** — dark, light, or both (the app ships dark by default with a `[data-theme="light"]` override).
- **typography** — the feel for the sans + mono families (and any specific fonts to load).
- **shape & density** — rounded vs. sharp, airy vs. compact.
- **mood** — a sentence or two; if the user has **Claude Design** files, accept them as references.
Do NOT propose concrete token values yet — that's the Theme tokens stage. Read the **Reskin base-studio-code** skill now; it is the source of truth for the token system and the guardrails (especially: `design/` is REFERENCE-ONLY — never edit it).

sections.name: Repos
sections.prompt: Link the user's **base-studio-code clone or fork** as the target repo — emit `<repo_link owner/repo>` for it. This blueprint edits that repo's `src/styles/tokens.css` (and, if needed, the fonts wired in `index.html`). It is self-referential: it is only useful against a base-studio-code checkout.

sections.name: Theme tokens
sections.blurb: Translate the look into concrete oklch values for every :root token.
sections.prompt: Translate the captured look into **concrete oklch values for every `:root` token** in `src/styles/tokens.css`, and matching values in the `[data-theme="light"]` block (and/or the dark default). Cover the full catalog: backgrounds `--bg-canvas/-panel/-elev/-elev2`, borders `--border/-border-soft`, foreground `--fg/-muted/-dim`, accent `--accent/-dim` (+ any `--accent-soft/-text`), and state colors `--success/-info/-violet/-danger`. Keep values in **oklch** (lightness, chroma, hue) — adjust hue for the brand, keep enough lightness/chroma separation that text stays readable and surfaces stay layered. Present the proposed token map (dark + light) as a table and get the user's confirmation. Per the skill: keep contrast accessible and never edit `design/`.

sections.name: Typography
sections.blurb: Pick + wire --sans / --mono and load the fonts.
sections.prompt: Choose the sans + mono families and wire them: set `--sans` and `--mono` in `:root`, and **load the fonts** (the Google Fonts `<link>` in `index.html`, or a self-hosted `@font-face`). Keep a robust system-font fallback stack on each var. If the user wants a size scale change, note it but prefer leaving base sizes alone unless asked. Confirm the picks with the user.

sections.name: Shape & density
sections.prompt: Tune the corner radii — `--r-sm` / `--r-md` / `--r-lg` (defaults 4 / 6 / 10px) — toward the desired roundness (sharper or softer), and adjust any spacing/density the look calls for. Keep changes token-driven where possible. Confirm with the user.

sections.name: Scope & light/dark
sections.blurb: Global retheme vs. scoped per-surface overrides; how light/dark resolves.
sections.prompt: Decide the scope: a **global** retheme (rewrite the `:root` + `[data-theme="light"]` tokens) vs. **scoped per-surface** overrides using the proven `.console-theme` pattern (override the tokens only under a surface's class). Confirm how light/dark resolves — the `[data-theme]` attribute wired through the Appearance settings page — and that both modes are covered. Keep the two-mode contract intact.

sections.name: Preview & verify
sections.blurb: Run the app / render-preview and confirm the look holds everywhere.
sections.prompt: Verify the reskin holds together: run the app (or the render-preview) and check the new look across the **chrome (titlebar/rail), console, planner, and settings** surfaces, in **both light and dark**. Confirm contrast/readability and that nothing reads broken. Capture any fixes as follow-up notes for the fleet.

sections.name: Plan the change
sections.blurb: Sequence the reskin into an executable plan.
sections.prompt: Sequence the reskin into a concrete, executable plan for the fleet: the token rewrite (dark + light), the font wiring, the radii/density changes, and any scoped overrides — as ordered work items against `src/styles/tokens.css` (and `index.html` for fonts). Keep it to the minimum set of edits; do not refactor unrelated styles, and do not touch `design/`.

sections.name: Permissions
sections.blurb: Plan the least-privilege agent that executes the reskin.
sections.prompt: Plan the agent fleet that executes the reskin — typically a single worker scoped to `src/styles/**` (+ `index.html` for fonts), least-privilege, with `design/` explicitly out of its write boundary. Pipe the FleetPlan to `bsc-plan fleet set`.

sections.name: Land it
sections.blurb: The fleet lands the reskin on a branch / PR.
sections.prompt: Have the fleet land the reskin on a feature branch and open a PR against the user's clone — the token edits, font wiring, and radii/density changes — so the user can review the new look before merging. No production deploy; this is a local repo restyle.

bundledSkills.name: Reskin base-studio-code
bundledSkills.desc: How to re-theme base-studio-code safely: the design-token catalog, oklch palette conventions, the [data-theme] light/dark mechanism, scoped per-surface overrides, font swaps, and the design/=reference-only guardrail.
bundledSkills.content:
# Reskin base-studio-code

The app's entire look is **design tokens** in `src/styles/tokens.css`. To reskin it you rewrite token values (and optionally add scoped overrides + swap fonts) — you almost never touch component code.

## Hard guardrail
- **`design/` is REFERENCE-ONLY — never edit anything under `design/`.** It's the browser-rendered prototype, not the live app. The live styles are `src/styles/tokens.css`.

## The token catalog (`:root` in `tokens.css`)
- **Backgrounds (layering, darkest→lightest):** `--bg-canvas`, `--bg-panel`, `--bg-elev`, `--bg-elev2`
- **Borders:** `--border`, `--border-soft`
- **Foreground:** `--fg`, `--fg-muted`, `--fg-dim`
- **Accent:** `--accent`, `--accent-dim` (some surfaces also use `--accent-soft`, `--accent-text`)
- **State:** `--success`, `--info`, `--violet`, `--danger`
- **Typography:** `--sans` (Inter), `--mono` (JetBrains Mono)
- **Radii:** `--r-sm` (4px), `--r-md` (6px), `--r-lg` (10px)

## oklch conventions
- All colors are **oklch** — `oklch(L C H)`: L = lightness (0–1), C = chroma (~0–0.4), H = hue (deg). Keep this format.
- **Rebrand = shift the hue** (and tune chroma) consistently across `--accent*` and the tinted surfaces; keep the **lightness ramp** of the `--bg-*` set so panels stay layered.
- Preserve **contrast**: `--fg` on `--bg-canvas` must stay readable; keep state colors distinguishable.

## Light / dark
- The app ships **dark by default** (`:root`), with a **`[data-theme="light"]`** block that overrides the same tokens for light mode. The mode is toggled via the `data-theme` attribute, wired through the **Appearance settings** page.
- Reskin **both**: update the `:root` (dark) values AND the `[data-theme="light"]` values. Don't leave one mode stale.

## Scoped per-surface overrides
- To retheme just one surface (not the whole app), follow the existing **`.console-theme`** pattern: redeclare the tokens inside a surface-scoped selector so they cascade only there. Use this for accent surfaces; use the global `:root`/`[data-theme]` rewrite for an app-wide reskin.

## Font swap
1. Set `--sans` / `--mono` in `:root`, keeping a system fallback stack (e.g. `"YourFont", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif`).
2. **Load the font** — add/replace the Google Fonts `<link>` in `index.html`, or self-host with `@font-face`.
3. Don't hard-code font names in components; everything reads `var(--sans)` / `var(--mono)`.

## Verify
- Run the app (or render-preview) and check **chrome, console, planner, settings** in **both light and dark**. Confirm readability/contrast and that surfaces stay layered.

## Scope discipline
- Keep edits to `src/styles/tokens.css` (+ `index.html` for fonts). Don't refactor unrelated CSS, and never edit `design/`.
